name: Ledgerline
author: MarshalX
description: A price history for a market that keeps almost none: every page you read at the Merchant is written down, your own completed sales are copied out of its collect ledger before you empty it, and your listings are checked against the page for undercuts.

preview.alt: Panel 1 of 3, The ledger, recorded prices over their own trends Panel 2 of 3, Your listings, undercuts washed red Panel 3 of 3, What sold, what a buyer paid, per item

companionReasons.lorebind: publishes what every item is called, so a price row reads as an item rather than as an id

keybinds.label: Show or hide the price ledger
